Set up

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(ggridges)
library(GGally)
library(patchwork) 

# Clear all variables from environment
rm(list = ls())

# Set input files
merg_dir  <- here("data", "phenotype", "merged")
participants_rds <- here(merg_dir, "preregistration-amendment_participants.rds")
  
# Read in data
participants_df <- readRDS(participants_rds)
